visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, flowing black hair and a bright, energetic smile wears a black spaghetti-strap tank top. She is framed in a medium close-up, speaking animatedly toward the camera in a brightly lit indoor hallway. Yellow and white text boxes appear frequently near her face. (2) The scene shifts to a professional medical office environment. The woman is seated at a consultation desk across from a female doctor who is wearing a white medical coat. The woman holds a small white plush cat and uses expressive hand gestures while talking. (3) A series of high-quality digital animations are presented, showing anatomical cross-sections of the female pelvic region and the application of medical technology. Labels and icons emphasize the effects of the treatment on internal tissues. (4) The woman is shown lying on a medical bed in a clean, clinical treatment room. She is resting her head on a pink pillow and appears relaxed yet slightly expectant. A medical professional's hands are visible briefly as they prepare equipment for a non-invasive procedure. (5) After the treatment, the woman returns to a seated position in a cozy, well-lit reception area. She shares her experience with the camera, looking relieved and happy, holding the same white plush cat and pointing toward clinic signage in the background.

The main speaker's voice remains dominant but the pacing slows slightly as she describes a personal concern. (3) The female doctor's voice is introduced; it is lower in pitch, professional, calm, and enunciated with broadcasting-level clarity. A soft 'ding' sound effect accompanies the appearance of key information. (4) During the treatment description, the female voice becomes more contemplative and hushed, but remains positive. Digital UI sound effects like soft clicks occur periodically. (5) The video concludes with the main female voice rising in arousal and pitch variability, expressing excitement and satisfaction, while the BGM swells slightly in volume before a final fade.
